--All Site Audit Report
SELECT
	Audit_Log.Au_Ref,
    Audit_Log.Au_Dtm AS AU_Action_DateTime,
    Audit_Log.Au_UserId,
	UserHD.name AS Au_User_Name,
    Audit_Log.Au_Action,
    CASE
        WHEN Audit_log.AU_Area = 0 THEN
            'User Login/Logout'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 1 THEN
            'Resident Details'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 2 THEN
            'Resident Contacts'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 3 THEN
            'Resident Discharge'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 103 THEN
            'Resident Discharge'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 4 THEN
            'Resident Death'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 104 THEN
            'Resident Death'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 5 THEN
            'Resident Admission'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 105 THEN
            'Resident Admission'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 6 THEN
            'Personal Allowance Transaction'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 7 THEN
            'Resident Diary'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 8 THEN
            'Account Details'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 9 THEN
            'Standing Order'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 10 THEN
            'Additions/Overrides'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 11 THEN
            'Billing Profiles'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 12 THEN
            'Billing Calendars'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 13 THEN
            'Invoice Production'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 14 THEN
            'Receipts Posting'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 16 THEN
            'Global Fee Update'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 18 THEN
            'Site Distribution'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 17 THEN
            'Period End'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 15 THEN
            'Enquiry Details'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 50 THEN
            'User Details'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 19 THEN
            'Fee Additions/Overrides'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 25 THEN
            'Final Invoice Flag'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 24 THEN
            'Snapshot & AdHoc Billing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 21 THEN
            'Account Processing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 23 THEN
            'Account Invoicing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 20 THEN
            'Fees Processing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 22 THEN
            'Fees Invoicing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 26 THEN
            'Nominal Period End'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 27 THEN
            'Resident Home Transfer'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 100 THEN
            'Site Access Changes'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 29 THEN
            'Contract Details'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 31 THEN
            'Contract Processing (Contract)'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 33 THEN
            'Contract Invoicing (Contract)'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 34 THEN
            'Adjustment Invoicing'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 30 THEN
            'Contract Processing (Calendar)'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 32 THEN
            'Contract Invoicing (Calendar)'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 35 THEN
            'Account Charge Rates'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 51 THEN
            'Interface'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 36 THEN
            'Direct Debit'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 37 THEN
            'Room Rates'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 38 THEN
            'Advance Notice Letters'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 39 THEN
            'Parameters'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 40 THEN
            'Room Availability'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 53 THEN
            'Stakeholder Account'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 52 THEN
            'StakeholderResident'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 54 THEN
            'Stakeholder Res Diary Type'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 56 THEN
            'Stakeholder Res Contact Type'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 106 THEN
            'Reconciliation Statement'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 41 THEN
            'PA Transaction Site Allocation'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 42 THEN
            'Fund Source Emails'
        WHEN Audit_log.AU_Area = 43 THEN
            'Invoice Numbering'
        WHEN Audit_Log.AU_Area = 44 THEN
            'ETL Process Load'
        ELSE
            'Unknown Audit Area'
    END AS Au_Area2,
    CASE
        WHEN User11B.User_Id IS NOT NULL THEN
            User11B.User_Id
        WHEN CandRes.Res_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            CandRes.Res_Code
        WHEN CandFs.AccNo IS NOT NULL THEN
            CandFs.AccNo
        WHEN Prof7.Pro_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            Prof7.Pro_Code
        WHEN Site8.SiteId IS NOT NULL THEN
            Site8.SiteId
        WHEN Site9.SiteId IS NOT NULL THEN
            Site9.SiteId
        WHEN CandCalH.Cal_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            CandCalH.Cal_Code
        WHEN Enq10.Enq_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            Enq10.Enq_Code
        WHEN Cal13.Cal_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            Cal13.Cal_Code
        WHEN ContBillHd14.CobCode IS NOT NULL THEN
            ContBillHd14.CobCode
        WHEN Cal15.Cal_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            Cal15.Cal_Code
        WHEN PriDirectDHd.BatchNo IS NOT NULL THEN
            CAST(PriDirectDHd.BatchNo AS varchar(10))
        WHEN Room7.Room_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            Room7.Room_Code
        WHEN Site10.SiteId IS NOT NULL THEN
            Site10.SiteId
        WHEN PriRes.Res_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            PriRes.Res_Code
        WHEN PriAcc.AccNo IS NOT NULL THEN
            PriAcc.AccNo
        WHEN CandMoveRes.Res_Code IS NOT NULL THEN
            CandMoveRes.Res_Code
        ELSE
            ''
    END AS Au_CandCode,
	Au_Info,
    rtrim(Audit_Log.Au_Info)
    + CASE
            WHEN User11B.Name IS NOT NULL THEN
                ' - ' + User11B.Name
            WHEN CandCalD.Caldet_Ref IS NOT NULL THEN
                ' (' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, CandCalD.StartDate, 103) + ' - ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, CandCalD.EndDate, 103)
                + ')'
            WHEN CandCalD2.Caldet_Ref IS NOT NULL THEN
                ' (' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, CandCalD2.StartDate, 103) + ' - ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, CandCalD2.EndDate, 103)
                + ')'
            ELSE
                ''
        END AS Au_Info2
FROM 
	Audit_Log (NOLOCK)
    
	LEFT JOIN Resident AS Res1 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Room_Dt AS Room1 (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Locations AS Loc1 (NOLOCK)
                ON Loc1.Loc_Ref = Room1.Loc_Ref
            ON Room1.Room_Ref = Res1.Room_Ref
        ON Res1.Res_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 1, 52 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Resident AS Res2 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Room_Dt AS Room2 (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Locations AS Loc2 (NOLOCK)
                ON Loc2.Loc_Ref = Room2.Loc_Ref
            ON Room2.Room_Ref = Res2.Room_Ref
        ON Res2.Res_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 2, 27 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Movement AS Move3 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Resident AS Res3 (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Room_Dt AS Room3 (NOLOCK)
                JOIN Locations AS Loc3 (NOLOCK)
                    ON Loc3.Loc_Ref = Room3.Loc_Ref
                ON Room3.Room_Ref = Res3.Room_Ref
            ON Res3.Res_Ref = Move3.Res_Ref
        ON Move3.Move_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND (
                   Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 3, 4, 5 )
                   OR (
                          Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 103, 104, 105 )
                          AND Audit_Log.Au_PriKey != 0
                      )
               )
    LEFT JOIN Resident AS Res3A (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Room_Dt AS Room3A (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Locations AS Loc3A (NOLOCK)
                ON Loc3A.Loc_Ref = Room3A.Loc_Ref
            ON Room3A.Room_Ref = Res3A.Room_Ref
        ON Res3A.Res_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 103, 104, 105 )
           AND Audit_Log.Au_PriKey = 0
    
	LEFT JOIN PMoney_Dt AS PMD4 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN PMoney_Hd AS PMH4 (NOLOCK)
            ON PMH4.PMH_Ref = PMD4.PMH_Ref
        ON PMD4.PMD_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 6
    
	LEFT JOIN Resident_Dy AS ResDy5 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Resident AS Res5 (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Room_Dt AS Room5 (NOLOCK)
                JOIN Locations AS Loc5 (NOLOCK)
                    ON Loc5.Loc_Ref = Room5.Loc_Ref
                ON Room5.Room_Ref = Res5.Room_Ref
            ON Res5.Res_Ref = ResDy5.Res_Ref
        ON ResDy5.Res_Dy_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 7
    LEFT JOIN FundSrc_Hd AS Fund6 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Resident AS Res6 (NOLOCK)
            JOIN Room_Dt AS Room6 (NOLOCK)
                JOIN Locations AS Loc6 (NOLOCK)
                    ON Loc6.Loc_Ref = Room6.Loc_Ref
                ON Room6.Room_Ref = Res6.Room_Ref
            ON Res6.Res_Ref = Fund6.Res_Ref
        ON Fund6.Fs_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 8, 9, 10, 19, 25, 24, 21, 53, 23 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Profiles AS Prof7 (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN Site_Join AS SJ7 (NOLOCK)
            ON SJ7.LinkKey = Prof7.Pro_Ref
               AND SJ7.LinkTable = 'PROFILES'
        ON Prof7.Pro_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 11
    
	LEFT JOIN Site AS Site8 (NOLOCK)
        ON Site8.Site_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 13, 17, 26, 100, 14 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Site AS Site9 (NOLOCK)
        ON Site9.Site_Ref = Audit_Log.Site_Ref
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 18, 106, 41, 39, 43 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Enquiry AS Enq10 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Locations AS Loc10 (NOLOCK)
            ON Loc10.Loc_Ref = Enq10.Loc_Ref
        ON Enq10.Enq_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 15
    
	LEFT JOIN User_Hd AS User11A (NOLOCK)
        JOIN SiteUser AS SU11 (NOLOCK)
            ON SU11.User_Ref = User11A.User_Ref
        ON User11A.User_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 50
    
	LEFT JOIN User_Hd AS User11B (NOLOCK)
        ON User11B.User_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 50
    
	LEFT JOIN User_HD AS UserHD
		ON UserHD.User_ref = Audit_log.User_Ref

	LEFT JOIN Site AS Site12 (NOLOCK)
        ON Site12.Site_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 20, 22, 38 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Calendar_Hd AS Cal13 (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN Site_Join AS SJ13 (NOLOCK)
            ON SJ13.LinkKey = Cal13.Cal_Ref
               AND SJ13.LinkTable = 'CALENDAR_HD'
        ON Cal13.Cal_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area = 12
    
	LEFT JOIN ContBillHd AS ContBillHd14 (NOLOCK)
        ON ContBillHd14.CobHd_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 29, 31, 33, 34 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Calendar_Hd AS Cal15 (NOLOCK)
        ON Cal15.Cal_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 30, 32 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Room_Dt AS Room7 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Locations AS Loc11 (NOLOCK)
            ON Loc11.Loc_Ref = Room7.Loc_Ref
        ON Room7.Room_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 37, 40 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Resident AS CandRes (NOLOCK)
        ON CandRes.Res_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND (
                   (Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 27 ))
                   OR (
                          Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 103, 104, 105 )
                          AND AU_PriKey = 0
                      )
               )
    LEFT JOIN Movement AS CandMove (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Resident AS CandMoveRes (NOLOCK)
            ON CandMoveRes.Res_Ref = CandMove.Res_Ref
        ON CandMove.Move_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND (
                   Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 103, 104, 105 )
                   AND AU_PriKey != 0
               )
    LEFT JOIN FundSrc_Hd AS CandFs (NOLOCK)
        ON CandFs.Fs_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 8, 9, 10, 19, 25, 24, 21, 23, 35 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Calendar_Dt AS CandCalD (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Calendar_Hd AS CandCalH (NOLOCK)
            ON CandCalH.Cal_Ref = CandCalD.Cal_Ref
        ON CandCalD.CalDet_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 20, 22, 38 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Calendar_Dt AS CandCalD2 (NOLOCK)
        JOIN Calendar_Hd AS CandCalH2 (NOLOCK)
            ON CandCalH2.Cal_Ref = CandCalD2.Cal_Ref
        ON CandCalD2.CalDet_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_CandKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 21, 23 )
    
	LEFT JOIN DirectD_Hd AS PriDirectDHd (NOLOCK)
        ON PriDirectDHd.DDHd_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 36 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Site AS Site10 (NOLOCK)
        ON Site10.Site_Ref = Audit_Log.Site_Ref
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 51, 39 )
    
	LEFT JOIN Resident AS PriRes (NOLOCK)
        ON PriRes.Res_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 52 )
    
	LEFT JOIN FundSrc_Hd AS PriAcc (NOLOCK)
        ON PriAcc.Fs_Ref = Audit_Log.Au_PriKey
           AND Audit_Log.Au_Area IN ( 53 )
WHERE Audit_Log.Au_Dtm
      BETWEEN '@{variables('vStartDate')}' AND '@{variables('vEndDate')}'
      AND Audit_log.SQLProdFlag IN ( 8880, 216791758, 718271, 5001, 5002, 42 )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 1, 52 )
              OR Loc1.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 2, 27 )
              OR Loc2.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 3, 4, 5 )
              OR (
                     Loc3.Site_Ref = 74
                     OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
                 )
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 103, 104, 105 )
              OR (
                     Loc3.Site_Ref = 74
                     AND Audit_Log.Au_PriKey != 0
                 )
              OR (
                     Loc3A.Site_Ref = 74
                     AND Audit_Log.Au_PriKey = 0
                 )
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 6
              OR PMH4.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 7
              OR Loc5.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 8, 9, 10, 19, 25, 24, 21, 23, 53, 35 )
              OR Loc6.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 11
              OR SJ7.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 13, 26, 100, 14 )
              OR Site8.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 17
              OR Site8.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Au_PriKey = 0
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 18, 106, 41, 39, 43 )
              OR Site9.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 0
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 15
              OR Loc10.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 50
              OR SU11.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 20, 22, 38 )
              OR Site12.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 12
              OR Cal13.SiteFilter = 0
              OR SJ13.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 51
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 0
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 36
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 39
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 0
          )
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area != 42
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 29, 31, 33, 34, 30, 32 ))
      AND (
              Audit_Log.Au_Area NOT IN ( 37, 40 )
              OR Loc11.Site_Ref = 74
              OR Audit_Log.Site_Ref = 74
          )
      AND (Audit_Log.Au_Area != 28)
ORDER BY Audit_Log.Au_Ref

    ,Profiles.Pro_ref
    ,Profiles.Billdays AS bill_days_or_nights
    ,Profiles.Billdeath AS bill_day_of_death
    ,Profiles.Billdod AS bill_day_of_discharge
    ,Profiles.Billdoa AS bill_day_of_admission
    ,Profiles.Invprint

    H.Home_Ref

    ,SiteName

    ,attach_pension_books
    --,UserMemo
    --,NoInvDec
    ,sg_BankAcc
    --,UseFlag
    --,OOSExtraContrib
FROM 
    dbo.LocalAuthProfiles AS P

    LEFT JOIN ColdHarbourHomeID AS H
        ON H.SITEID = P.SiteId

SELECT
	DIRECTD_DT.DDDT_REF,
	DirectD_Hd.DDHD_REF,
	FundSrc_Hd.AccNo,
    Resident.Res_Code,
	DirectD_DT.INVOICE_NO AS InvoiceNo,
    DirectD_Dt.DDTranType AS DDTypeID,
	CASE 
		WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = 1 THEN 'New DD'
		WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = 17 THEN 'Standard DD'
		WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = 18 THEN 'Cancel DD'
		WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = 19 THEN 'Change of value'
		ELSE ''
	END AS DDTranType,
    DirectD_Dt.Amount AS DDAmount,
    isnull(DirectD_Dt.Due_Date, DirectD_Dt.Inv_Date) AS DueDate,
    DirectD_Dt.Submitted AS SubmittedDate,
    DirectD_Dt.Allocated AS AllocationStatus,
    DirectD_Hd.BatchNo,
	S.SITEID
FROM 
	DirectD_Dt (NOLOCK)
    
    JOIN DirectD_Hd (NOLOCK)
        ON DirectD_Hd.DDHd_Ref = DirectD_Dt.DDHd_Ref

    JOIN FundSrc_Hd (NOLOCK)
		ON FundSrc_Hd.FS_Ref = DirectD_Dt.FS_Ref

	JOIN Resident (NOLOCK)
		ON Resident.Res_Ref = FundSrc_Hd.Res_Ref
		
	JOIN Site AS S(NOLOCK)
        ON S.Site_Ref = DIRECTD_HD.Site_Ref

SELECT
    DD.[SITEID]
    ,H.HOME_REF
    ,H.HomeName
    ,DD.DDDT_REF
    ,DD.[DDHD_REF]
    ,DD.[AccNo]
    ,DD.[RES_CODE]
    ,DD.[InvoiceNo]
    ,DD.[DDTypeID]
    ,DD.[DDTranType]
    ,DD.[DDAmount]
    ,DD.[DueDate]
    ,DD.[SubmittedDate]
    ,DD.[AllocationStatus]
    ,DD.[BatchNo]
FROM 
    ColdHarbour.STGDirectDebits AS DD

    LEFT JOIN GRG.HOME AS H
        ON H.SiteID = DD.SiteID

SELECT 
	InvPosting.POST_REF,
	Site.SiteId AS siteid,
	Site.SiteName as sitename, 
	P.PRODESC AS AccProfile,
	CONCAT(RTRIM(CONTACT.FORENAMES), RTRIM(CONTACT.SURNAME)) AS FundSourceName,
	InvPosting.account_No AS AccNo, 
	R.RES_CODE AS RES_CODE,
	InvPosting.CRE_DATET AS CreatedAt,
	InvPosting.DUE_DATE AS DueDate,
	InvPosting.INV_DATE AS TransactionDate,
	CASE 
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'U' THEN 'Receipt - To account'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'I' THEN 'Invoice'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'C' THEN 'Credit'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'J' THEN 'Adjustment'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'R' THEN 'Receipt - To transaction'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'N' THEN 'System Receipt'
		ELSE ''
	END AS TransactionType,
	InvPosting.Ref1 AS Reference1, 
	InvPosting.Ref2 AS Reference2, 
	InvPosting.Value AS TransactionValue, 
	InvPosting.Balance AS TransactionBalance
	,INVPOSTING.TRAN_TYPE
	,INVPOSTING.AN_CODE1 AS AnalysisCode
	,INVPOSTING.USERCOMM AS UserComment
FROM 
	InvPosting WITH (NOLOCK)
	
	LEFT JOIN FUNDSRC_HD AS ACC WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ACC.ACCNO = InvPosting.ACCOUNT_NO
		AND ACC.ENDDATE IS NULL

	LEFT JOIN CONTACT_HD AS CONTACT WITH (NOLOCK) 
		ON CONTACT.CONTACT_REF = ACC.CNTA_DET_REF

	LEFT JOIN PROFILES AS P WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON P.PRO_REF = ACC.PRO_REF

	LEFT JOIN RESIDENT AS R WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON R.RES_REF = INVPOSTING.RES_REF

	LEFT JOIN Site WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON Site.Site_Ref = InvPosting.Site_Ref

WITH DirectDebitData AS (
	SELECT 
		CONCAT(RTRIM(Contact_Hd_Res.Forenames), ' ', RTRIM(Contact_Hd_Res.Surname)) AS [Debtor Name],
		REPLACE(CASE
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.BkSortCode != '' THEN
				DirectD_Dt.BkSortCode
			ELSE
				isnull(Contact_Hd_FS.BkSortCode, space(8))
		END, '-', '') AS [Debtor Sort Code],
		CASE
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.BankAcc != '' THEN
				RTRIM(DirectD_Dt.BankAcc)
			ELSE
				RTRIM(FundSrc_Hd.BankAcc)
		END AS [Debtor Account Number],
		RTRIM(Resident.Res_Code) AS [Collection Details],
		DirectD_Dt.Amount,
		CAST(DirectD_Dt.Amount AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [Debtor Amount],
		CASE 
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = '17' THEN '17 - Standard Ongoing Collection'
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = '01' THEN '01 - First Collection'
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = '18' THEN '18 - '
			WHEN DirectD_Dt.DDTranType = '19' THEN '19 - '
			ELSE DirectD_Dt.DDTranType
		END AS [Transaction Type],

		DirectD_Dt.DDHd_Ref,
		DirectD_Dt.DDDT_REF,
		DirectD_Dt.DUE_DATE
	FROM 
		DirectD_Dt (NOLOCK)
		JOIN DirectD_Hd (NOLOCK)
			ON DirectD_Hd.DDHd_Ref = DirectD_Dt.DDHd_Ref
			   AND DirectD_Hd.BatchNo
			   BETWEEN 0 AND 9999999999
		JOIN FundSrc_Hd (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN Contact_Dt AS Contact_Dt_FS (NOLOCK)
				JOIN Contact_Hd AS Contact_Hd_FS (NOLOCK)
					ON Contact_Hd_FS.Contact_Ref = Contact_Dt_FS.Contact_Ref
				ON Contact_Dt_FS.Cnta_Det_Ref = FundSrc_Hd.Bank_Det_Ref
			JOIN Resident (NOLOCK)
				JOIN Contact_Dt AS Contact_Dt_Res (NOLOCK)
					JOIN Contact_Hd AS Contact_Hd_Res (NOLOCK)
						ON Contact_Hd_Res.Contact_Ref = Contact_Dt_Res.Contact_Ref
					ON Contact_Dt_Res.Cnta_Det_Ref = Resident.Cnta_Det_Ref
				JOIN Room_Dt (NOLOCK)
					JOIN Locations (NOLOCK)
						JOIN Site (NOLOCK)
							ON Site.Site_Ref = Locations.Site_Ref
						ON Locations.Loc_Ref = Room_Dt.Loc_Ref
					ON Room_Dt.Room_Ref = Resident.Room_Ref
				ON Resident.Res_Ref = FundSrc_Hd.Res_Ref
			ON FundSrc_Hd.FS_Ref = DirectD_Dt.FS_Ref
	WHERE 
		DirectD_Dt.Due_Date
		BETWEEN '17530101' AND '29991231'
		AND DirectD_Dt.Allocated != 'X'
		and DirectD_Dt.Submitted IS NULL
		and DirectD_Dt.DDTranType IN ( '01', '17', '18', '19' )
		AND Locations.Site_Ref = @{item().Site_ref}
)
SELECT 
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Name],
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Sort Code],
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Account Number],
	DirectDebitData.[Collection Details],
	SUM(DirectDebitData.[Debtor Amount]) AS [Debtor Amount],
	DirectDebitData.[Transaction Type]

	--,DirectDebitData.DUE_DATE
FROM
	DirectDebitData
--WHERE
--	DirectDebitData.[Collection Details] = 'MM0182'
GROUP BY
	DirectDebitData.DDHd_Ref,
	DirectDebitData.DUE_DATE,
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Name],
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Sort Code],
	DirectDebitData.[Debtor Account Number],
	DirectDebitData.[Collection Details],
	DirectDebitData.[Transaction Type]
